page.intro.brief.title: Your editorial partner.
page.intro.brief.text: Describe what you want. Your partner asks until topic, depth and focus fit.
page.intro.research.title: Understand first. Then tell.

production.title: The drafting
production.hint: Necessary follow-up research and internal corrections belong to these steps. Saved script versions can be read while the drafting runs.
production.readable_text: You can read the saved texts now. Each episode shows its review status; the drafting goes on.
production.issues.review: Open points of the quality review
production.finished.title: The scripts are ready.
production.finished.text: Read the episodes and give feedback if needed. Then you decide on the recording.
production.active_hint: You can look at other pages meanwhile. The job keeps running.
reader.updated: There is a newer text or review state for this episode. The text you opened stays while you read.
reader.preview.draft: The draft is saved in full. Dialogue polish and quality reviews are still to come.
reader.preview.polished: The dialogue is revised. The final quality reviews are still to come.
reader.preview.reviewed: This version has passed the automatic reviews. Publishing the job is still to come.
reader.preview.tail: You can read already; this preview has no audio approval yet.
reader.more: Further episodes appear here automatically as soon as a complete draft is saved.
expression.count: {tags} tags in {segments} segments, marked in the text
expression.how: Gemini plays them as a sound or a pause; they are not read aloud.
expression.rejected: The model gave no valid tags; this episode is recorded without expression.
expression.redo_hint: Placing it again asks the text model anew; then read and approve the episode once more.
expression.none: No expression placed yet. It is made automatically after every script run; for this episode it is still missing.
expression.none_hint: Without placed expression the recording places it itself, then without you having read it first.
expression.title: Expression for the recording
expression.stage.text: The text model chooses from twelve kinds ({kinds}) and places them sparingly where they fit, at most in about every fourth segment. You see them marked while reading; the Gemini recording speaks exactly these.
review_notes.title: Review notes
review_notes.hint: These points did not prevent publishing. The reviews name them as a limit of their own verdict or as an observed pattern.
advisory.redefined_term: “{term}” is defined anew {definitions} times in this episode although the term is known from an earlier episode.
advisory.repeated_hedging: {reminders} reminders that an example is invented or not measured; at most {limit} are intended.
advisory.long_cold_open: The first spoken passage has {words} words; above {limit} the episode starts without a breather.
advisory.over_target_duration: An estimated {estimated_minutes} minutes against {target_minutes} planned, that is {percent} percent of the target; above {limit_percent} percent the episode counts as too long.
advisory.long_turns: {turns} turns of more than {over_words} words, the longest with {longest_words}; turns of about {turn_words} words are intended and at most {limit} longer ones, such as for one step of the worked example.
advisory.low_partner_share: Host B speaks {percent} percent of the words; about a third is intended, below {floor_percent} percent the episode sounds like a lecture.
spoken.title: Spoken form
spoken.hint: Only the sound changes. The text of this episode, its hash and your approval stay as they are.
spoken.label: How should this segment be spoken?
spoken.saved: Spoken form saved. “Re-render” records only this segment again.
spoken.none: No differing spoken form; the table applies to this segment.
speech.hosts_both: Give both host names or leave both fields empty.
speech.saved: Saved. Changed spoken forms need a new audio approval; changed host names apply to new script runs.
script.empty.waiting.title: The first script draft is still being written.
script.empty.waiting.text: This page updates by itself as soon as a complete draft is saved. The other episodes may go on meanwhile.
script.empty.outline.title: Set the common thread first.
script.empty.outline.text: Check and approve the table of contents. Then the complete conversation is written.
reader.preview_feedback: Once the drafting is finished, you can give feedback for another revision and decide on the recording.
reader.feedback.title: Your feedback
reader.feedback.label: What is missing or does not sound right yet?
reader.revise_hint: A revision goes through dialogue polish and review again. It gets a new audio approval.
pronunciation.hint: The voice reads these words by its own rule. Check them before the approval; a spoken form changes only the sound, never the text.
key.inline_hint: The key stays only in this Studio server's memory and must be entered again after a restart.
paused.hint: Careful: a stopped run ({runs}) is bound to these details. After saving it can no longer be resumed and must be started anew; finished results stay readable.
paused.confirm: A stopped run ({runs}) is bound to these details and can no longer be resumed after saving. It must then be started anew; finished results stay readable. Save anyway?
notes.title: Editorial notes
notes.hint: Standing corrections for all future episodes of this project. They apply in writing, in the dialogue and in both reviews; the evidence rules come first. A change leads to a new script run.
notes.label: What should always be done differently?
speech.title: Spoken forms and host names
speech.hint: Applies to all episodes of this project. The pauses between the voices are an audio setting for all projects (Settings).
speech.forms_label: Spoken forms · one line per entry: written = spoken
speech.forms_hint: A hyphen separates words, a dot between characters does not: the entry “KL” reaches “KL-Abweichung”, the entry “V3” leaves “V3.2-Exp” unchanged.
speech.hosts_hint: Both names or none. With names the hosts address each other by them in the script, and transcript and reading page show them; without names they stay host A and host B. Changed names apply to new script runs.
speech.save: Save spoken forms and host names
listening.title: Listening review
listening.hint: The review sheet is in the export next to the MP3. Only a person sets this.
listening.done: I have listened to this whole episode.
listening.label: What did you notice while listening?
queue.refused: The approval waited in the queue but does not start: {error}
queue.waits_key.openrouter: Approved · waiting for the OpenRouter key (place {position}). After a Studio restart the key must be entered again; then the episode starts by itself.
queue.waits_key.google: Approved · waiting for the Google key (place {position}). After a Studio restart the key must be entered again; then the episode starts by itself.
queue.place: Approved · waiting in the queue for place {position}.
audio.size: about {minutes} min of audio · {characters} characters of spoken text
audio.size_note: Estimated from the text (130 words per minute); segments already made come from the cache and are not requested again.
queue.title: Recording queue · {count}
queue.key_missing.openrouter: Key missing: the OpenRouter key lived only in the Studio's memory and is gone after a restart. As soon as it is stored in the approval above, the episodes start by themselves.
queue.key_missing.google: Key missing: the Google key lived only in the Studio's memory and is gone after a restart. As soon as it is stored in the approval above, the episodes start by themselves.
queue.hint: Approved episodes start by themselves in this order as soon as a place is free; the Studio must stay open for that. Before each start it is checked that script, voices and expression still match the approved state.
approve_all.title: Approve all read episodes · {count}
approve_all.confirm: I have read these {count} scripts, with their expression, and approve them for audio with the audio provider and voices shown. I want to start the API recording.
approve_all.key_field: The field for it is in the approval above.
approve_all.hint: As many start at once as places are free; the others queue up and start by themselves.
approval.alternating: the roles swap from episode to episode
approval.text.current: Recording ready · this version is recorded already
approval.text.outdated: Recording of an earlier version ready · changed: {changes}
approval.text.unvoiced: Ready for review · not recorded yet
approval.provider.google: Gemini speaks a whole conversation passage with both voices at a time through Google and uses your Google key for it. Your graphics card is not needed.
approval.provider.openrouter: Gemini makes the speech through OpenRouter and uses your API credit for it. Your graphics card is not needed for the recording.
approval.provider.qwen: Qwen makes the speech on your computer and uses your graphics card.
approval.provider.tail: The browser window may be closed; the Studio server must stay open.
approval.pronunciation_none: No unusual words in the published text.
approval.expression_marked: marked in the text while reading; the approval covers exactly these.
approval.expression_none: Not placed yet: the recording places it itself, without you having read it.
approval.pauses_text: {same} / {change} / {chapter} ms · same voice, voice change, chapter
approval.confirm: I have read this script and approve this version for audio with the audio provider and voices shown.
approval.confirm_api: I want to start the API recording.

audio.sentence.api.one: Approving confirms that you have read the script; then {provider} records it with {voices}, billed to your key.
audio.sentence.api.other: Approving confirms that you have read the scripts; then {provider} records them with {voices}, billed to your key.

kit.chapters_hint: Spotify recognises chapters only from three chapters at least 30 seconds apart.
kit.long: Episode description for Spotify and Apple Podcasts ({characters} of {limit} characters)
kit.sources: {listed} of {total} sources are in the text; all of them in {file} and in the ZIP download.

podcast_kit.outdated: An episode has changed or been recorded again since this companion kit. Rebuild it; the descriptions are kept while the episode plans and chapters stay the same.

podcast_kit.unrecorded.one: The episode is not recorded yet: its chapters have no timestamps in the transcript. Rebuild after recording.
podcast_kit.unrecorded.other: {recorded} of {count} episodes recorded: in the transcript the other episodes' chapters have no timestamps. Rebuild after recording.

audio.phase.loading: The speech model is loading for this chapter; the first time this can take several minutes.
job.elsewhere: This job keeps running outside this Studio; it was started before the Studio restarted.
job.elsewhere_stoppable: “Stop” ends it; finished steps stay saved.
job.elsewhere_unknown: The Studio does not know its process and cannot stop it; it ends by itself, and then things go on here.
job.silence: No new message from the worker process for {minutes} min.
job.silence_loading: Loading the speech model is taking unusually long.
job.silence_long: Long single steps can look like this.
job.silence_tail: If it stays that way: “Stop”, then resume; finished steps stay saved.
audio_job.other_running: Another job is running right now.
progress_view.stopping_tail: The other running episodes still finish this stage; then the job stops and this page names the reason.
progress_view.auto_hint: The view updates by itself. A model call can take several minutes.
progress_view.series_note: Every episode has passed its own review. Now one call checks the whole series together: terms, prerequisites and whether the finale holds what the episodes support. If it finds problems across episodes, the affected passages are revised once and checked again, then the series is checked again. After that the scripts are published.
timing.call_stale: Last reported model call started {age} ago
timing.calls_parallel: {count} model calls are running at once, the oldest for {age}
timing.changed: Last change in the run: {age} ago
timing.stale: No answer from the Studio for {age}. Shown is the state as of {time}; whether the job is still running shows after the next connection. The connection is checked again automatically.

insight.candidates: plus {count} search hits that are not read evidence yet

insight.quiet_call: No interim message with content for the current call yet, for {age}.

stop.interrupted.title: Stopped
stop.interrupted.text: The job was stopped. {resume} carries on where it was interrupted; everything finished stays saved.
stop.worker_start.title: The job did not start
stop.worker_start.text: The worker process could not start. Quit the Studio, reopen it and start the step again.
stop.processing_failed.title: Unexpected program error
stop.processing_failed.text: A program error ended the job. {resume} tries the step again; everything finished stays saved. The technical details name the cause.
stop.invalid_local_data.title: Local processing failed
stop.invalid_local_data.text: An error occurred while processing saved files. {resume} tries again; the technical details name the cause.
stop.project_busy.title: Project busy
stop.project_busy.text: Another job, such as a run on the command line, holds this project. When it is finished, {resume}.
stop.timeout.title: Time limit of a model call
stop.timeout.text: A single model call exceeded its time limit; it was not counted. {resume} repeats it. If it stops again, the step is too large for one call.
stop.claude_structured_output.title: Answer in the wrong format
stop.claude_structured_output.text: Claude twice gave no answer in the required format (one retry already happened automatically). {resume} tries the call again.
stop.stall.title: Model call without output
stop.stall.text: A model call gave no output for a long time and was ended; it was not counted. {resume} repeats it.
stop.claude_failed.title: Claude call failed
stop.claude_failed.text: {resume} repeats the call. If the step stops again, check the connections under “Brief”.
stop.codex_failed.title: Codex call failed
stop.codex_failed.text: {resume} repeats the call. If the step stops again, check the connections under “Brief”.
stop.openrouter_connection.title: OpenRouter not reachable
stop.openrouter_connection.text: {resume} repeats the call. If the step stops again, check the connections under “Brief”.
stop.openrouter_request.title: OpenRouter request refused
stop.openrouter_request.text: {resume} repeats the call. If the step stops again, check the connections under “Brief”.
stop.openrouter_unavailable.title: OpenRouter temporarily unavailable
stop.openrouter_unavailable.text: A little later, {resume}; the call is then repeated.
stop.openrouter_speech_request.title: Gemini request failed
stop.openrouter_speech_request.text: {resume} makes the missing spoken segments; finished ones stay saved.
stop.invalid_audio.title: Unusable audio data
stop.invalid_audio.text: The speech output delivered unusable audio. {resume} makes the affected segments again.
stop.audio_processing_failed.title: Audio assembly failed
stop.audio_processing_failed.text: FFmpeg could not process the audio. {resume} tries the assembly again; the speech recordings stay saved.
stop.loudness_failed.title: Loudness measurement failed
stop.loudness_failed.text: {resume} tries the assembly again; the speech recordings stay saved.
stop.tts_worker_failed.title: Local speech output failed
stop.tts_worker_failed.text: Qwen could not speak. If graphics memory is short, close other programs, then {resume}; finished segments stay saved.
stop.tts_environment.title: Local speech output not set up
stop.tts_environment.text: The Qwen environment is not ready. Check the setup as described in docs/OPERATIONS.md or choose Gemini in Settings under “Audio”; then {resume}.
stop.search_not_observed.title: Web search not observable
stop.search_not_observed.text: A research call ran no observable web search, twice. The Studio continues by itself after a pause.
stop.invalid_model_output.title: Unreadable model answer
stop.invalid_model_output.text: The model's answer was incomplete or unreadable. {resume} asks again. If the step had already used up its correction attempts, it stops again at once; then “Resume with fresh attempts” gives it new ones.
stop.research_questions_open.title: Sub-questions still open
stop.research_questions_open.text: Some sub-questions are still open; {resume} researches them further. Finished answers stay saved.
stop.question_scope_unresolved.title: Scope of the sub-questions unsettled
stop.question_scope_unresolved.text: An older Studio version stopped here. The scope review now decides by itself in its last pass and notes its objections at the plan approval; {resume} now gets past this point.
stop.invalid_speech.title: Implausible Gemini recording
stop.invalid_speech.text: A segment came back too short, too long or with long silence twice; the message names it. {resume} records it again; finished segments stay saved.
stop.invalid_expression.title: Expression not placed
stop.invalid_expression.text: Placing the expression tags has used up its automatic corrections. {resume} may stop at the same place again. On the “Read scripts” page the expression of this episode can be placed again; then read it and approve again.
stop.missing_executable.title: Program cannot start
stop.missing_executable.text: A program the Studio needs (Codex, Claude Code or a helper) could not start. Check the installation; “Check connections” shows the state; then {resume}.
stop.unsupported_codex_launcher.title: Codex launcher not supported
stop.unsupported_codex_launcher.text: The Studio cannot start the Codex program it found directly. Reinstall Codex CLI or the VS Code extension, or enter the path under runtime.codex_executable, “Check connections”, then {resume}.
stop.unsupported_claude_launcher.title: Claude launcher not supported
stop.unsupported_claude_launcher.text: The Studio cannot start the Claude Code program it found directly. Reinstall Claude Code, “Check connections”, then {resume}.
stop.openrouter_forbidden.title: OpenRouter refuses access
stop.openrouter_forbidden.text: OpenRouter refused the request (HTTP 403). The message names the reason, often the key's credit limit. Check the limit, the key's permissions and the provider rules in the OpenRouter account; store another key if needed, then {resume}.
stop.openrouter_search_unsupported.title: OpenRouter cannot search here
stop.openrouter_search_unsupported.text: The chosen OpenRouter text model cannot run the evidenced web search. In the engine room under “Continue with …”, choose a subscription for this run and {resume}, or change the choice for new runs in Settings.
stop.invalid_backend.title: Invalid text model choice
stop.invalid_backend.text: Provider, model or output limit of the saved text choice are not supported. In the engine room under “Continue with …”, choose another provider for this run and {resume}, or make a valid choice in Settings and start the step again.
stop.audio_approval_required.title: Audio approval missing
stop.audio_approval_required.text: There is no matching audio approval for this script version. Approve the script you read on the Recording page; then the recording starts.
stop.credential_in_prompt.title: Credentials in the text
stop.credential_in_prompt.text: A text for the model contained an API key and was therefore not sent. Remove the key from chat, notes or attachments and store it only in Settings under “OpenRouter key”; then start the step again.
stop.credential_in_response.title: Credentials in the answer
stop.credential_in_response.text: The model's answer contained credentials and was discarded; nothing of it was saved. Start the step again; if it happens again, please report it.
stop.invalid_output_schema.title: Invalid answer format for the connection
stop.invalid_output_schema.text: The Studio gave the model an answer format the connection does not accept. This is a bug in the Studio, not a login problem; {resume} would repeat it. Please report it; finished results stay readable.
stop.unsupported_run.title: Older run
stop.unsupported_run.text: The Studio does not resume this older kind of run. Finished results stay readable; the way on is a new run.
stop.missing_outputs.title: Step without a result
stop.missing_outputs.text: A step delivered no result files. This is a bug in the Studio; {resume} can repeat it. Please report it if it stays at the same place.
stop.worker_stop.title: Worker process cannot be stopped
stop.worker_stop.text: The worker process could not be stopped; the access rights were not enough. End it in the Task Manager or restart the computer; then {resume} at the saved point.
stop.research_context_incomplete.title: Cited source passages unreadable
stop.research_context_incomplete.text: A synthesis cites source passages that are no longer readable; {resume} would repeat it unchanged. Please report it. The verified partial answers stay readable.
stop.script_review_failed.title: The quality review has objections
stop.script_review_failed.text: After the automatic corrections the quality review still reports evidence errors or objections to scope or structure; the open points are on this page. Points on clarity, depth and dialogue no longer stop the run; they stand as a note with the script. “Resume with fresh attempts” gives the review three new corrections. {resume} alone helps only after a Studio update; otherwise the run stops again without new calls.
stop.dialogue_polish_failed.title: Dialogue polishing needs correction
stop.dialogue_polish_failed.text: After both automatic corrections the review of the dialogue polishing still has objections to meaning, completeness, speaker roles or intro and outro; the open points are on this page. {resume} helps if the rules have changed since the stop, for example after a Studio update; otherwise the run stops at the same place again without new calls. Then a new table of contents helps.
stop.subscriptions_exhausted.title: Both subscriptions used up
stop.subscriptions_exhausted.text: Codex and Claude have no quota right now. After the reset, {resume} carries on.
stop.claude_quota_exhausted.title: Claude quota used up
stop.claude_quota_exhausted.text: After the reset, {resume} carries on; with the automatic subscription choice Codex takes over as soon as it has quota. A job set to Claude only can carry on with Astra; finished work stays valid.
stop.quota_exhausted.title: Codex quota used up
stop.quota_exhausted.text: After the reset, {resume} carries on. A job set to Astra only can carry on with Claude; finished work stays valid.
stop.openrouter_rate_limit.title: OpenRouter request limit
stop.waiting_for_quota.title: Provider limit reached
stop.jev_unavailable.title: Jev does not answer
stop.jev_unavailable.text: The gap probe with Jev got no answer after several attempts. {resume} carries on where it stood; segments already answered are not asked again.
stop.openrouter_credits.title: OpenRouter credit used up
stop.openrouter_credits.text: Raise the credit or the key limit at OpenRouter, then {resume}. Waiting alone does not help here, so the Studio does not resume by itself.
stop.subscription_required.title: No subscription usable
stop.subscription_required.text: Neither Codex nor Claude is logged in and usable. Run “codex login” or “claude auth login” in a terminal, then {resume}.
stop.codex_missing.title: Codex not found
stop.codex_missing.text: Install Codex CLI or the OpenAI extension for VS Code and restart the Studio, then {resume}.
stop.claude_missing.title: Claude Code not found
stop.claude_missing.text: Install Claude Code and log in, restart the Studio, then {resume}.
stop.claude_version.title: Claude Code too old
stop.claude_version.text: Update Claude Code, restart the Studio, then {resume}.
stop.openrouter_key_required.title: OpenRouter key missing
stop.openrouter_key_required.text: Store the OpenRouter key here. It stays only in this Studio server's memory and must be entered again after every restart.
stop.anthropic_key_required.title: Anthropic key missing
stop.anthropic_key_required.text: Store the Anthropic API key here. It stays only in this Studio server's memory and must be entered again after every restart; every call is billed to your Anthropic account.
stop.anthropic_authentication.title: Anthropic key refused
stop.anthropic_authentication.text: Anthropic refused the key. Check the key and store it again, then {resume}.
stop.anthropic_credits.title: Anthropic credit used up
stop.anthropic_credits.text: Top up the credit in the Anthropic Console, then {resume}. Waiting alone does not help here, so the Studio does not resume by itself.
stop.anthropic_rate_limit.title: Anthropic API rate limit
stop.anthropic_rate_limit.text: The Anthropic API refused too many requests at once. The Studio resumes by itself after a pause; finished work stays valid.
stop.claude_api_auth_mismatch.title: Claude did not run on the API key
stop.claude_api_auth_mismatch.text: Claude Code did not run the call on the Anthropic API key. Update Claude Code with “claude update”, then {resume}.
stop.perplexity_key_required.title: Perplexity key missing
stop.perplexity_key_required.text: Store the Perplexity key for the web search here. It stays only in this Studio server's memory and must be entered again after every restart.
stop.perplexity_authentication.title: Perplexity key refused
stop.perplexity_authentication.text: Perplexity refused the key. Check the key and store it again, then {resume}.
stop.perplexity_credits.title: Perplexity credit used up
stop.perplexity_credits.text: Top up the credit at Perplexity, then {resume}. Waiting alone does not help here.
stop.perplexity_rate_limit.title: Perplexity rate limit
stop.perplexity_rate_limit.text: Perplexity refused too many search requests at once. The Studio resumes by itself after a pause.
stop.perplexity_failed.title: Web search unreachable
stop.perplexity_failed.text: Perplexity was unreachable or returned nothing. {resume} tries the search again; finished work stays valid.
stop.invalid_search_selection.title: Search selection rejected
stop.invalid_search_selection.text: The model repeatedly named sources the search had not found. {resume} asks it again; if the step stops again, another text model helps.
stop.cost_limit_required.title: Money limit missing
stop.cost_limit_required.text: This run bills an API key and needs a money limit in USD. Set it here for this run; the limit for new runs is in Settings.
stop.cost_limit_reached.title: Money limit reached
stop.cost_limit_reached.text: The run has spent its money limit. Finished work stays saved; you approve a higher limit for this run here.
stop.invalid_key.title: OpenRouter key missing
stop.invalid_key.text: Store the OpenRouter key here. It stays only in this Studio server's memory and must be entered again after every restart.
stop.openrouter_authentication.title: OpenRouter key refused
stop.openrouter_authentication.text: OpenRouter did not accept the key. Store a valid key; it stays only in this Studio server's memory.
stop.google_key_required.title: Google key missing
stop.google_key_required.text: Store the Google key for Gemini audio here. It stays only in this Studio server's memory and must be entered again after every restart.
stop.invalid_google_key.title: Google key invalid
stop.invalid_google_key.text: Store the Google key for Gemini audio here. It stays only in this Studio server's memory and must be entered again after every restart.
stop.google_unavailable.title: Google not reachable
stop.google_unavailable.text: Google was temporarily unreachable. {resume} carries on at the same passage; finished passages stay saved.
stop.google_connection.title: Connection to Google interrupted
stop.google_connection.text: The connection dropped. {resume} carries on at the same passage; finished passages stay saved.
stop.ffmpeg_missing.title: FFmpeg missing
stop.ffmpeg_missing.text: Set up FFmpeg: on Windows, run scripts\setup-ffmpeg.ps1 once; on macOS and Linux, sh scripts/setup.sh. Then restart the Studio and {resume}; the speech recordings stay saved.
stop.ffprobe_missing.title: FFprobe missing
stop.ffprobe_missing.text: Set up FFmpeg: on Windows, run scripts\setup-ffmpeg.ps1 once; on macOS and Linux, sh scripts/setup.sh. Then restart the Studio and {resume}; the speech recordings stay saved.
stop.research_plan_review.title: The research plan awaits approval
stop.research_plan_review.text: Check the projection on the Research page and approve the plan. Until then no further model call is used.
stop.research_questions_blocked.title: Sub-questions await your decision
stop.research_questions_blocked.text: For every blocked sub-question: try again or accept it as a gap, then {resume}.
stop.review_ready.title: Table of contents ready for review
stop.review_ready.text: Check episodes and chapters and approve the plan or have it revised.
stop.research_budget_insufficient.title: The call limit is not enough
stop.research_budget_insufficient.text: The approved call limit will probably not last to the end. Answers and scope are kept; you approve a higher limit here.
stop.script_budget_insufficient.title: The call limit is not enough
stop.script_budget_insufficient.text: The approved call limit is not enough for the remaining steps. Finished work stays saved; you approve a higher limit here.
stop.plan_exceeds_allowance.title: The research plan does not fit the call limit
stop.plan_exceeds_allowance.text: The research plan needs more model calls than approved. Approve a higher limit, then the research goes on planning.
stop.chat_budget.title: Chat limit reached
stop.chat_budget.text: The conversation with the editorial team has used up its call limit for this project. Approve a higher limit, then send again.
stop.inputs_changed.title: Inputs changed since the stop
stop.inputs_changed.text: Since the stop, details this run is bound to have changed, such as the brief, voices, host names, notes, spoken forms or a Studio update. It cannot be resumed; finished results stay readable.
stop.script_edited.title: Script changed since the approval
stop.script_edited.text: The script was changed since your approval. Read the current version and approve it for audio again.
stop.invalid_plan.title: The table of contents stays contradictory
stop.invalid_plan.text: The automatic correction did not resolve the contradiction after three rounds; {resume} would repeat the same check. A new table of contents from the existing research gets new correction rounds.
stop.research_required.title: Research missing or not matching
stop.research_required.text: The table of contents needs a verified, current dossier. Finish the research first or start it anew.
stop.teaching_design_failed.title: The teaching plan stays incomplete
stop.teaching_design_failed.text: The automatic revision did not resolve every point of criticism; {resume} would present the same points again. The open points are under “Message”. With your note, the run drafts this episode's teaching plan anew, with new correction rounds; the approved table of contents and the other episodes stay. Or a new table of contents: the research stays, and this run's teaching plans and scripts are made anew.
stop.teaching_design_failed.plain: The teaching plan of episode {episode} still has open points after three corrections; a redraft with these points as a note costs about 4–6 calls; the other episodes stay.
stop.teaching_research_required.title: Explanatory foundations missing
stop.teaching_research_required.text: The teaching plan lacks foundations backed by evidence, and the automatic supplementary research could not close the gap. The open questions are on this page. {resume} helps if the rules have changed since the stop, for example after a Studio update; otherwise the run stops at the same place again without new calls. If the supplementary research has used up its corrections, “Resume with fresh attempts” gives it new ones; the review keeps the points it raised. Otherwise the way on is a new research that covers these questions, or a new table of contents that does without them.
stop.research_gap_unread.title: Unread evidence for reported gaps
stop.research_gap_unread.text: The review reports gaps for which the source material still has unread passages. Only a new research settles this.
stop.prompt_too_large.title: Task too large for the model
stop.prompt_too_large.text: The task does not fit into the chosen model's context window. The call was neither started nor counted. {resume} tries again, because a sub-question's task changes between attempts and after Studio updates; if it still does not fit, the run stops again at once and at no cost. Otherwise choose a model with a larger window in Settings, such as Automatic or Codex, and start the step again.
stop.claude_output_limit.title: Answer too long for one call
stop.claude_output_limit.text: The answer was longer than one Claude call can deliver, and {resume} would repeat it unchanged. Choose another model in Settings and start the step again.
stop.claude_budget_cap.title: Money limit of one call reached
stop.claude_budget_cap.text: A single Claude call reached its money limit. Choose another model in Settings and start the step again.
stop.openrouter_truncated.title: Answer cut off at the token limit
stop.openrouter_truncated.text: OpenRouter cut the answer off. Choose a model with a higher output limit in Settings and start the step again.
stop.no_readable_sources.title: No source readable
stop.no_readable_sources.text: None of the sources found could be read as text; the retrieval report on this page names the reasons. Add source links or your own files under “Brief” and research anew.
stop.duration_exceeded.title: Episode too long
stop.duration_exceeded.text: The episode exceeds the maximum length. Ask for a shorter version on the “Read scripts” page and approve it again.
stop.series_review_failed.title: The series review has objections
stop.series_review_failed.text: After the automatic corrections the review of the whole series still has objections; the open points are on this page. {resume} starts a new review round whose verdict may differ. If it stops again, a new table of contents helps.
stop.teaching_review_failed.title: Teaching review not passed
stop.teaching_review_failed.text: After the automatic corrections the teaching review still has objections; the open points are on this page. {resume} starts a new review round whose verdict may differ. If it stops again, a new table of contents helps.
stop.authentication_required.title: Login expired
stop.login.claude: Run “claude auth login” in a terminal.
stop.login.either: Run “codex login” or “claude auth login” in a terminal, depending on the subscription.
stop.authentication_required.watch: While the Studio is open it checks the login every 5 minutes and continues as soon as it is valid.
stop.series_review_failed.fresh: “Resume with fresh attempts” gives the series correction a new round.
stop.openrouter_privacy.jev.title: OpenRouter privacy settings exclude Jev
stop.openrouter_privacy.jev.text: Your OpenRouter account allows only providers that meet its privacy setting; TypeSafe with Jev is not one of them. Allow it under openrouter.ai/settings/privacy, then {resume}. The gap probe carries on where it stood.
stop.openrouter_privacy.gemini.title: OpenRouter privacy settings exclude Gemini
stop.openrouter_privacy.gemini.text: Your OpenRouter account allows only providers without data retention (Zero Data Retention); Google's speech model is not one of them. Allow providers without this commitment under openrouter.ai/settings/privacy, then {resume}.
stop.google_authentication.title: Google key refused
stop.google_authentication.fallback: Google did not accept the key.
stop.google_quota.title: Google quota used up
stop.google_quota.text: {message} After the quota resets or is raised in Google AI Studio, {resume}.
stop.google_quota.fallback: The Google quota for Gemini audio is used up.
stop.google_speech_request.title: Google refuses the audio request
stop.google_speech_request.text: {message} Check voices, speech model and style in Settings, then {resume}.
stop.research_budget_exhausted.calls.tex: The approved call limit is used up. The work so far stays saved; you approve a higher limit here.
stop.research_budget_exhausted.search.te: The approved limit for web searches is used up. The work so far stays saved; you approve more search rounds here.
stop.review_disagreement.dispute.title: Dispute in the overall review
stop.review_disagreement.dispute.text: The overall review contradicts an earlier objection. On the Research page you decide whom to follow; then the job carries on.
stop.review_disagreement.unanchored.text: The overall review raises an objection it cannot itself anchor in evidence it has read. No automatic follow-up research starts for it, and {resume} would present the same review again. The verified partial answers stay readable; the way on is a new research.
stop.invalid_research_checkpoint.title: A saved intermediate state no longer fits
stop.invalid_research_checkpoint.text_up: A saved intermediate state or an approval of this run no longer matched its inputs. The Studio has been updated since the stop, perhaps with exactly this fix: {resume} tries again with the new version. If the run stops at the same place again, the only way on is a new run.
stop.invalid_research_checkpoint.text: A saved intermediate state or an approval of this run no longer matches its inputs, for example after a Studio update. {resume} would stop at the same place again. Finished results stay readable; the way on is a new run.
stop.invalid_source_snapshot.title: Source in two versions
stop.invalid_source_snapshot.text: A supplementary research loaded a source again that has changed since the research. {resume} helps if a Studio update changed the rule; otherwise the run stops at the same place again without new calls. Then the way on is a new table of contents.
stop.correction.title: Correction attempts used up
stop.correction.script.text: The model has used up this step's automatic correction attempts. {resume} tries the step again; if it saved its rejected answers, it stops at the same place again without a new call. Then “Resume with fresh attempts” gives it new attempts where offered; otherwise a new table of contents helps.
stop.correction.research.text: The model has used up the automatic correction attempts for this check, or a review rule rejected a change; the details are in the run folder. {resume} tries the step again, and the verified partial answers are kept; a bug fixed in the meantime then lets it pass. If it stops at the same place again, “Resume with fresh attempts” gives the step three new attempts; the rejected answers stay readable.
stop.correction.invalid_script.text: After three corrections the episode's script still breaks its length or source mapping. {resume} writes the episode anew with fresh attempts; everything else stays saved.
stop.correction.reasked.text: The check rejected its answers three times as malformed. {resume} asks this step anew; no rejected answer is replayed.
stop.generic.title: Stopped
stop.generic.text: The work step has stopped. {resume} tries it again; everything finished stays saved. If it stops at the same place again, the only way on is a new run.
stop.generic.text_code: The work step has stopped (code {code}). {resume} tries it again; everything finished stays saved. If it stops at the same place again, the only way on is a new run.

assignment.ResearchDecision: Measure the passages provided against the checkpoints and derive an answer backed by evidence, or the next targeted reading and search step.
assignment.AnswerReview: Compare the proposed answer independently with the original passages: are the claims backed and every checkpoint answered?
assignment.QuestionSearch: Search for additional original sources for the sub-question still open.
assignment.QuestionPlan: Split the guiding questions into research tasks that can be answered one by one.
assignment.QuestionScopeReview: Check that every research task has a clearly bounded scope.
assignment.ResearchDiscovery: Search for original sources on the agreed guiding questions.
assignment.ResearchDossier: Combine the evidence and answers at hand into a coherent dossier.
assignment.DossierPatch: Add to or correct the assigned findings in the dossier.
assignment.SourceReview: Compare the dossier's claims with their original sources.
assignment.ResearchAssessment: Check that the dossier covers the agreed scope of explanation.
assignment.ReopenPlan: Assign specific review objections to the research questions they concern.
assignment.phase.awaiting_plan_approval: Waiting for the research plan's approval; until then no model call is used.
assignment.phase.synthesis: Combining the verified answers into the dossier.
assignment.phase.audit: Running the final review of the assembled dossier.

assignment.warning.one: The last work step brought no new evidence or search hits and no passed answer review.
assignment.warning.other: The last {count} work steps brought no new evidence or search hits and no passed answer review.
